tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind lists, the chat transcript and grouped settings pages. Dark is TensorGrid's ground (#0C0F1A), the same colour as the splash and launcher tile.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default container: cards, grouped-list cells, the composer, top and bottom bars when not glass.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: search fields, segmented-control tracks, the off-state switch track.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and snackbars-on-surface; always paired with `elevation-2`. Dark mode lifts by lightness, not shadow.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets; pair with `elevation-3` and `scrim` behind.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Snackbars and tooltips, which must stand apart from whatever they cover.

tokens.name: code-surface
tokens.usage: Fenced code blocks and inline code inside messages.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind dialogs and modal sheets.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface, `bg` and `accent-container` (≥12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, list subtitles, helper text. ≥6.6:1 on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-overlay`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled-looking hints that must still be readable — meets 4.5:1 on every surface, including `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and list separators only — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, outlined buttons, checkboxes and the off switch — ≥3:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive colour: filled buttons, the send button, selected states, on-switch tracks, progress. Derived from the brand seed #4F8CFF, darkened in light mode so white text passes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`. Dark mode uses ink-dark text, because the lighter accent fails with white.

tokens.name: accent-container
tokens.usage: Tonal fills: selected chips, selected list rows, the tonal button.

tokens.name: on-accent-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent-container`.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥6:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard/switch-access focus ring, drawn 2px outside the control. ≥4.8:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: bubble-user
tokens.usage: The user's own message bubble. Dark mode steps down from `accent` to a deep navy so long messages don't glare.

tokens.name: on-bubble-user
tokens.usage: Text on `bubble-user`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: error text, the delete button. Always with an icon or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a filled `danger` button.

tokens.name: danger-container
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and field-error callouts.

tokens.name: on-danger-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `danger-container`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations (saved, copied, connected). A bluish green, off the red–green axis; still always paired with a check icon.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Background of success banners.

tokens.name: on-success-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `success-container`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Cautions: rate limits, token budget nearly spent, offline cache shown. Pair with a warning icon.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners and the server banner.

tokens.name: on-warning-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `warning-container`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The Tchat seed blue, fixed in both themes. Identity only: the logo, the splash mark, illustration. 3.2:1 on white — never body text in light mode.

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: The end stop of the logo gradient. Identity only; never a UI state colour.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: TensorGrid's ground: the splash screen and launcher-icon tile in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty-state and onboarding heroes only; one per screen. M3 `headlineLarge`.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Large screen titles before they collapse into the top bar. M3 `headlineMedium` / `headlineSmall`.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Top-bar titles, dialog and sheet titles. M3 `titleLarge`.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Conversation titles in the list, row primary text that must out-rank its subtitle. M3 `titleSmall` (now semibold, so it differs from body).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Here's a summary of the three options you asked about.
styles.usage: Chat messages and the composer — the reading surface. M3 `bodyLarge`.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Choose how Tchat looks on this device.
styles.usage: List rows, settings descriptions, dialog body. M3 `bodyMedium`.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary meta: subtitles, timestamps, helper and error text. M3 `bodySmall` — the app's most-used style, raised from 12px.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Badges and endpoint tags. The smallest text in the app — nothing goes below 12px. M3 `labelSmall`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Fenced code blocks and inline code in messages.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Off-grid values found in the code (2, 3, 6, 10, 14, 18) map to the nearest step.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges only: badge insets, icon-to-dot offsets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; stacked label-to-value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip row gap; bubble vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row vertical padding; gap between messages from the same sender; bubble horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on phones; card and sheet padding; list-row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between messages from different senders.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; space between grouped-list sections; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading; empty-state stack gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top inset of an empty state.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large separations: onboarding blocks, bottom clearance above the composer.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on onboarding and empty states.

radius.note: Six steps, down from nine distinct radii in the code. Nest smaller inside larger: inner = outer − padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, badges, the focus ring's corner on square controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small buttons, code blocks, menu items' pressed highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, cards, grouped-list cells, menus, banners, the composer field.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Message bubbles and the composer shell; buttons in the 48px height.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the top corners of bottom sheets (M3 extraLarge).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: switches, segmented thumbs, avatars, the send button, tags.

shadow.note: Light mode separates by shadow; dark mode separates by surface lightness, so its shadows are near-invisible on purpose.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards and the composer resting on `bg`.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, snackbars, the floating action button.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for anything tappable, on both platforms (pad the hit area, not the visual).

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, text fields, segmented controls and single-line list rows.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of compact buttons and chips (hit area still padded to `size-touch`).

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and text fields.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Standalone icon buttons, top-bar actions, list leading icons.

tokens.name: size-avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatars beside messages.

tokens.name: size-avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatars in lists and the account row.

tokens.name: size-avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Profile header.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Top-bar height on Android (iOS uses its native 44pt bar).

tokens.name: size-reading
tokens.usage: Max width of the chat transcript and settings content on tablets and foldables.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (content and container). Disabled text is exempt from contrast rules, so never use it for anything the user must read.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed-state overlay of `ink` (or `on-accent` on filled controls).

tokens.name: opacity-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/focus overlay on tablets with a pointer.

tokens.name: opacity-glass-tint
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass tint over sampled content — the legibility floor, from `GlassSurface.kt`.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Separators and card outlines with `border` (0.5pt on iOS glass).

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Input and outlined-button borders with `border-strong`; 2px with `accent` when focused.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus-ring width, drawn at a 2px offset.

meta.note: Values are the redesigned system; the extracted originals are listed in the Audit section.
